title: Light Australian Egg Noodles
description: A pungent and light Australian dish featuring egg noodles, perfect for a hangover cure, made without onion or garlic for a friendly option.
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large saucepan.
Add the egg noodles to the saucepan and cook according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, olive oil, ginger, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
In a large skillet, add the soy sauce mixture and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the green beans to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the beaten eggs and a splash of the hot chicken broth.
Stir the egg mixture into the skillet with the green beans and cook until the eggs are scrambled.
Drain the cooked egg noodles and add them to the skillet, stirring to combine with the egg and green bean mixture.
Deglaze the saucepan with a little bit of water to remove any stuck noodles, then add the deglazed liquid to the skillet.
Serve the light Australian egg noodles hot, garnished with additional grated ginger if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
